## Description

Plans (Clinic with one doctor ₹1,999 per month; Clinic ₹3,499 per doctor per month; Hospital custom) with separate INR and AED prices, seats, trial days and the feature list. An edit creates a new plan version: new subscriptions use it now, existing ones at renewal with 30 days' notice. Removing a feature never deletes data. Entitlements are read by the feature gate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a plan is edited, when it is saved, then a new version exists and current subscribers keep the old one until renewal.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a price changes, when a subscriber exists, then they are notified 30 days before it applies.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a feature is removed from a plan, when data exists, then the data stays.

## Notes / open questions

- The "Solo" plan is a one-doctor Clinic plan, not an individual account (ADR-016 (docs/adr/ADR-016-organisation-onboarding-and-approval.md, owner decision 10 Nov 2026)); revisit plan names and seat types (doctors, staff, patients) when this is built. This ticket replaces the hard-coded starter plan (1 doctor and 2 staff, patients uncapped) enforced from MDV-P1-069, and adds the owner's self-service upgrade.
